ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity dark field with approximately 15% high-intensity white/light-grey pixel clusters and streaks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dark grey/black base pigmentation with high-contrast white circular clusters localized at distal tips and scattered thin white linear segments across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an internal angle of approximately 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with frequent low-amplitude serrations and distinct notches, particularly visible on the inner margin of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature from the median notch extending to acute, slightly recurved distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, circular white pixel clusters (consistent with barnacle colonization) concentrated on the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) appearing as parallel and crossing tracks across the central and lower regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy scarring evidenced by multi-directional white linear marks and significant barnacle encrustation on the fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a brownish-yellow organic appendage or material attached to the distal tip of the right lobe.
